description:
REVIVED AS V2-1 — CRITICAL, ~90 min. Operator ruling 2026-08-12. This ticket was downgraded to low/post-deadline earlier today and is now the single largest eval unlock left. Read the whole of this description: the reason it is back is NOT the reason it was filed.

WHY THE DOWNGRADE WAS RIGHT AND WHY IT NO LONGER APPLIES.
Filed originally as 'keyboard accessibility is a broken promise'. That framing did not survive checking: keyboard placement appears in NO rubric criterion and in NO requirement in the R1-R50 register, and only one scored item cited it. Downgraded on that evidence.
The V2 audit (Fable, surface:55) found the stronger case the original framing missed: the grid is UNDRIVABLE by a snapshot-driven harness, and undrivable means UNJUDGEABLE. That does not cost style points — it costs four items outright, two of them cannot_judge, which are excluded from the denominator and therefore make 100% unreachable while they stand.

WHAT IT CLOSES: AIA-03 (w3, cannot_judge), AIA-04 (w3, partial), AIA-05 (w2, partial), AIA-06 (w2, cannot_judge). Ten of ai-agenda's eighteen weight, from one change. It is the largest single unlock remaining on the board.

HUMAN PROBLEM. An organizer on a keyboard, a screen-reader user, and every agent Marquee claims as a first-class operator (PHILOSOPHY section 3, 'agent-native by design ... no privileged surface') cannot schedule a session. The grid is the product's centerpiece and it is mouse-only.

GOOD LOOKS LIKE — CLICK-TO-PLACE AS A PEER OF DRAG, NOT A REPLACEMENT:
- Activating an unscheduled card (click or Enter) arms it and announces 'Placing: {title}'.
- Every free time x room cell becomes a real button, labelled 'Place at 10:00 · Room 2A'.
- Activating one places through the SAME placement API the drop handler calls. Not a parallel path — the same one, so persistence, conflicts and audit all come for free.
- A placed tile offers 'Move...' (re-entering the same mode) and 'Unplace'.
- Escape disarms.
- No layout shift when arming: reserve the state line. DESIGN.md craft rule — elements never jump.

DRAG MUST KEEP WORKING. This is additive. Do not regress the mouse path.

VERIFY, KEYBOARD-ONLY: place an unscheduled session; reload (it persists); place a same-speaker overlap and watch the conflict panel gain the double-booking; move it clear and watch the conflict clear; unplace it. THEN once via an agent snapshot, confirming the accessibility tree exposes the cells as named buttons — that snapshot check is the whole point of the ticket, so do not skip it.

SEQUENCING — SAME FILE AS MRQ-148 (in flight). AgendaPage.tsx. Start after MRQ-148's PR is cut, or coordinate with that agent directly. Do not run two agents blind in the same file. MRQ-157 (15-minute increments) is third in this chain and composes with the 'Place at {time}' buttons this ticket creates.

Source: .briefs/eval-gap-v2-human-lens.md section 4, V2-1.
title: Agenda placement is mouse-only: a keyboard or agent organizer cannot schedule a session in the UI
